_what: Provider access needed by an applicable setup requirement. Policy and requests use existing trusted operator workspace records; normal accounts only receive their own projection. Native tool inputs name a request, never an email or provider group. No source sends until its operator policy and this account's recorded mandate both permit it.
notice_text: If your setup requires access to a beta app, Trillion may arrange its invitation through the app provider using your verified account email.

words.heading: App access
words.revoked: Your access to the app was removed. Contact Trillion to restore it before another invitation.
words.waiting_after_invite: Check your account email for the invitation, then install and sign into Trillion. This step stays incomplete until the app signs in.
words.policy_missing: This is still being set up.
words.mandate_missing: Request access to let Trillion invite your verified account email.
words.email_missing: Confirm your account email before requesting this access.
words.not_required: This access is not required by your current setup.
words.setup_paused: Your AI setup is stopped. Restart setup before arranging another invitation. An invitation already started with the provider may still arrive; existing provider access is unchanged.
words.prepared: Your access request is prepared. Trillion is arranging the required access.
words.queued: Trillion has queued the access check.
words.canceled: Future invitation steps are canceled. An invitation already started with the provider may still arrive; existing provider access is unchanged.
words.unknown: Trillion could not confirm this access state. Try the same request again.
words.availability_stale: This app access check expired. Check access again for a current route.
